definitions.explanation: A small room in an office or building equipped with a sink, a kettle or hot water supply, and sometimes a microwave. Used by staff to make tea, wash cups, and take short breaks.

examples.japanese: {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}でお{茶|ちゃ}を{入|い}れた。
examples.english: I made tea in the kitchenette.

examples.japanese: {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}は{各階|かくかい}に{一|ひと}つずつある。
examples.english: There is one kitchenette on each floor.

examples.japanese: {昼休|ひるやす}みに{給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}で{同僚|どうりょう}と{雑談|ざつだん}するのが{日課|にっか}になっている。
examples.english: Chatting with colleagues in the kitchenette during lunch break has become part of my daily routine.

notes:
USAGE:
{給湯室|きゅうとうしつ} literally means "hot water supply room." It is the standard Japanese term for an office kitchenette or break area with a sink and hot water. In many Japanese offices, it functions as a communal space for making tea and coffee.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}でお{茶|ちゃ}を{入|い}れる (to make tea in the kitchenette)
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}を{掃除|そうじ}する (to clean the kitchenette)
- {給湯室|きゅうとうしつ}の{利用|りよう} (use of the kitchenette)
